title: The Reflection of Tomorrow

beats.text: Elias sat in the booth, the timestamp on Monitor 4 blinking November 22nd, 2026, despite his watch reading the 21st.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome grainy security monitor view of a corporate lobby

beats.text: The glitch was a nightly comfort, a window into a quiet tomorrow where he sipped lukewarm coffee and whispered to the silence, 'the glass is holding.'
beats.image_prompt: close up of a security guard face in dark shadows holding a cup

beats.text: In the future feed, a figure that looked exactly like him entered the frame, but his movements were stiff, like a marionette with severed strings.
beats.image_prompt: grainy CCTV footage of a stiff man walking down a dark hallway

beats.text: The future Elias stopped at the camera and tapped the glass from the inside, his eyes flat and white while he mouthed the words, 'the glass is holding.'
beats.image_prompt: close up of a blurry face on a monitor screen with a cracked lens

beats.text: As the real monitor cracked under his fingertips, Elias realized the footage wasn't showing him tomorrow, but rather the thing that had just stepped out of the screen behind him.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome dark room with a tall shadow standing behind a seated man

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
